extraction_notes: Extracted all ammonia synthesis activity points readable from Fig. 6a and Fig. 6b. The 2.5%Ru/CeO2–CS series appears in both panels; duplicate entries were not repeated. Exact 450 °C rates for 2.5%Ru/CeO2–CS, 2.5%Ru/CeO2–MS and 2.5%Ru/CeO2–NR were taken from the printed text/abstract rather than estimated from the plot. Supplementary Tables S1–S5 and Fig. S5 are referenced but not included in the provided full text/images; only the TOF value explicitly printed in the main text was extracted.
